name: Donkey Calf Raise
cues: Hinge at the hips and rest your forearms on a bench or rack in front of you
Stand on the step edge with your heels hanging and hips over your feet
Keep your knees close to straight and your back flat
Lower your heels as far as they go, then rise up high and pause
